anchors.prompt: A bright, lived-in home living room with a small wooden desk by a big window with sheer white curtains: on the desk a stack of papers, a mug of pens, reading glasses, a small potted plant and one single printed page lying face down; a bookshelf with books and framed family photos behind, a grey armchair with a knitted blanket. The doctor stands by the desk, looking at the viewer mid-sentence. Medium shot, waist up, room around him.
Same living room: he holds the single printed page against his chest with the blank back facing the viewer, looking at the viewer seriously.

Same living room: he holds up the printed page with both hands toward the viewer at chest height (a cream page with a green title, numbered boxes and a small diagram of a face, seen at an angle so no text is readable), serious face.
Same living room: he stands relaxed with the page lowered at his side and one hand in his pocket, friendly face.
Same living room: he holds up three fingers, casual smile.
Same living room: he points down toward the bottom of the frame with his index finger, smiling.
Same living room: he has turned toward the door on the side, looking back at the viewer with a curious raised eyebrow and a half smile.

clips.text: Bueno, ya se fue Carmen. Y ahora quiero que veas esto, que es lo que más me importa del video.
clips.action: He walks to the desk, picks up the single printed page from the desk, still face down, and turns to the viewer.

clips.text: Presten mucha atención a esta imagen. Es la parte más importante del video.
clips.action: He slowly turns the page around and holds it up toward the viewer with both hands, serious, as if presenting it.

clips.text: Y dicho sea de paso, esta hoja la hice igual que las páginas de mi guía completa. El perejil no está en la guía, eh: esto es de aquí.
clips.action: Back in the living room, he lowers the page to his side casually and talks to the viewer relaxed, one hand in his pocket.

clips.text: La guía es para la firmeza: qué comer para el colágeno, la rutina de noche en tres pasos, y el cuello.
clips.action: He counts three things on his fingers while he talks, casual.

clips.text: Si están viendo en el televisor, escaneen el código; si están en el teléfono, el enlace está abajo.
clips.action: He points toward the side of the frame as if at a code on screen, then points down toward the bottom of the frame.

clips.text: Pero lo de hoy ya lo tienes entero. Y me falta la otra mitad: lo que pasa cuando el perejil, en vez de ponértelo, te lo comes.
clips.action: He puts the page back on the desk, raises an eyebrow with a curious smile and starts walking out toward the kitchen.
